messages:
mike_r: Heads-up: I'm bringing up Halo-7B-lite for onboarding and int8 quant experiments. Model card seems to have a mix of NonCommercial + attribution + a line that might forbid redistribution of modified weights. Can we run quantized versions in Dedicated and also offer a quantized container to on-prem customers?
sophia: Link?
mike_r: https://models.example/halo-7b-lite - license excerpt below:

```
License: Halo Community License v1.0
- NonCommercial use allowed unless agreed otherwise
- Must provide attribution to original authors
- Redistribution of modified model weights is prohibited
```

ada: If redistribution is explicitly prohibited then shipping quantized weights to customers is a no-go. We can host the quantized model in Hosted/Dedicated (we don't hand over weights), but on-prem/air-gapped deliveries are tricky. Sam_legal? :eyes:
sam_legal: Short answer: quantization counts as creating a derivative. If the license bans redistribution of modified weights, we cannot distribute quantized weights or containers that include them. Two paths: (1) keep models inside our infrastructure (Hosted/Dedicated) so customers call an endpoint, (2) negotiate a commercial license or specific redistribution permission with the rights holder.

Also need to confirm whether "NonCommercial" applies — if so, enterprise customers can't use it commercially without a separate commercial license.

Please stop sharing weights externally until we confirm.

ci-bot: Ticket opened RL-4123 - halo redistribution & commercial-use clarification (assigned: sam_legal)
mike_r: A few operational follow-ups:
- We currently planned to build an OCI image with quantized weights to hand to on-prem customers. That would violate the clause if it's a derivative.
- For Dedicated we can proceed (we run inference on our infra).
- Alternative: provide a conversion script and a small wrapper so customers who own original weights can run quantization locally. That avoids redistribution.
sam_legal: Exactly. Provide the conversion tools and documentation, but do NOT ship the weights. If a customer requests us to perform conversion in their environment (e.g., customer-managed private), have them initiate a support request and sign a commercial redistrib/CLA if we need to do it for them — but legal must negotiate that with the licensor.

sophia: On the eval side: int8 so far shows ~3% reg drop on MMLU-style slices in initial runs. We'll run a larger eval sweep to quantify. If redistribution is blocked we should prioritize a robust conversion script + eval artifacts customers can run locally.
mike_r: I'll add an onboarding note to the model docs: "Do not distribute weights; provide conversion scripts + eval harness; contact legal for commercial license." Will also attach the RL-4123 ticket.

ada: :thumbsup:
sam_legal: I'll draft an outreach email to the model authors asking for a commercial redistribution option and clarification on whether providing quantized weights to paying enterprise customers is allowed under a paid license. Will update RL-4123.
mike_r: Thanks — pausing any packaging until we hear back.
